# Dependencies without generated-code identity

These are bindings for `fleet.common` from `../rev_a/configuration.brd`, generated by the last schema compiler of each variant before generated-code identity:

| Directory | Variant | Compiler | Identity it carries |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cpp/`, `cpp_c_storage/` | C++ owning, C++/C storage | `351a89e`, before #111 G1 | A4.2 configuration identity (`<NS>_QUARRY_SCHEMA_ID_*`, `quarry_cfg_<schema_id>`) |
| `c/` | plain C | `1c385cf`, before #111 G2 | #117 configuration identity (`QUARRY_NS_<body>_SCHEMA_ID_*`) |

**C++ variants:** #117 renamed the A4.2 macros, so a current dependent reports that the header predates generated configuration identity; that check runs first. The generated-code identity diagnostic for these variants is covered separately, by deleting the current compiler's `_CODE_ID_FORMAT` macro from an otherwise current header.

**Plain C:** the configuration identity macros already have their #117 names, so the configuration check passes and the dependent reports that the header predates generated-code identity.

The suffix keeps formatting hooks from rewriting genuine generator output. Don't regenerate these files with a newer compiler.
